surface-current-rule-3fc0544f.title: Surface Current Rule
surface-current-rule-3fc0544f.interpretation: Surface Current Rule: Shows that the tangential intensity field is only discontinuous in the presence of free moving charges on the boundary.

stationary-state-8963d27d.title: Stationary State
stationary-state-8963d27d.interpretation: Stationary State: The method of finding the allowed energy levels of a system by solving the H-operator.

state-degeneracy-0d6863f9.title: State Degeneracy
state-degeneracy-0d6863f9.interpretation: State Degeneracy: The rule that T-symmetry forces energy levels to come in pairs for odd-fermion systems.
state-degeneracy-0d6863f9.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

atomic-collapse-ec4c838e.title: Atomic Collapse
atomic-collapse-ec4c838e.interpretation: Atomic Collapse: The specific state where electrons and protons merge to form a dead star.

divergence-proof-ee095497.title: Divergence Proof
divergence-proof-ee095497.interpretation: Divergence Proof: Why the absence of charges in space forces light to be transverse.

packing-limit-af9a3e65.title: Packing Limit
packing-limit-af9a3e65.interpretation: Packing Limit: Why matter resists being crushed, because particles "refuse" to share states.
packing-limit-af9a3e65.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

general-flux-identity-68f3ecf9.title: General Flux Identity
general-flux-identity-68f3ecf9.interpretation: General Flux Identity: The fundamental rule asserting that the total flux is the projection of the vector field onto the surface manifold area bits.
general-flux-identity-68f3ecf9.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

inertial-state-d0f76407.title: Inertial State
inertial-state-d0f76407.interpretation: Inertial State: Why astronauts float—not because there is no gravity, but because they are "coasting" in it.
inertial-state-d0f76407.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

description-bound-835efcd1.title: Description Bound
description-bound-835efcd1.interpretation: Description Bound: The fact that there is a maximum amount of data you can know about a system at once.
description-bound-835efcd1.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

standard-space-a39994b6.title: Standard Space
standard-space-a39994b6.interpretation: Standard Space: The rule that space follows high-school geometry, with straight rulers and flat sheets.
standard-space-a39994b6.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

area-operator-action-0dcc507d.title: Area Operator Action
area-operator-action-0dcc507d.interpretation: Area Operator Action: The total area is a sum of contributions from each edge intersecting the surface.
area-operator-action-0dcc507d.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

tuning-8da28342.title: Tuning
tuning-8da28342.interpretation: Tuning: The relationship between the speed of space stretching and the pull of the matter within it.
tuning-8da28342.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

causal-boundary-e0d0c2b1.title: Causal Boundary
causal-boundary-e0d0c2b1.interpretation: Causal Boundary: The geometric surface defined by \( ds^2 = 0 \) that separates cause from effect.

molecular-chaos-postulate-2ae5b546.interpretation: Molecular Chaos Postulate: The statistical rule assuming that particles enter a collision with zero prior correlation, allowing for independent probability product.
molecular-chaos-postulate-2ae5b546.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

oscillator-ground-state-wavefunction-822.title: Oscillator Ground State (Gaussian)
oscillator-ground-state-wavefunction-822.interpretation: Provides the spatial probability amplitude for the state of minimum vibrational energy.
oscillator-ground-state-wavefunction-822.symmetry_origin: The Gaussian form required to minimize the product of position and momentum variance.
oscillator-ground-state-wavefunction-822.limits_and_boundary: Represents the most localized state possible for a given potential strength, saturating the Heisenberg uncertainty bound.

greens-function-integral-solution-ident-.title: Integral Solution via Green's Function
greens-function-integral-solution-ident-.interpretation: Expresses the general solution to an inhomogeneous differential equation by convolving the source distribution f with the Green's function (propagator).
greens-function-integral-solution-ident-.symmetry_origin: The translational invariance and linearity of the interaction vacuum.
greens-function-integral-solution-ident-.limits_and_boundary: Identifies the Green's function as the 'Propagator' that carries information from the source to the observation point.

retardation-effect-identity-1-540023ac-0.title: Retarded Scalar Potential of a Charge Distribution
retardation-effect-identity-1-540023ac-0.interpretation: Expresses the electromagnetic scalar potential at a given observation point and time by integrating the source charge density over retarded time, accounting for the finite speed of light propagation.
retardation-effect-identity-1-540023ac-0.symmetry_origin: Lorentz invariance of the Maxwell equations and the green's function solution to the wave equation.
retardation-effect-identity-1-540023ac-0.limits_and_boundary: Reduces to the classical instantaneous electrostatic Coulomb potential in the limit where the speed of light c approaches infinity.

semantic_variables.\\Phi: Scalar potential at the observation point
semantic_variables.\\mathbf{r}: Position vector of the observation point
semantic_variables.\\rho: Charge density of the source distribution
